basic_details.job_title: Lucknow University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 24 Research Assistant, Young Professional Posts

The engagement carries a pay of Rs. 50,000 per Month for Young Professional and Rs. 35,000 per Month for Research Assistant. content_sections.heading: Lucknow University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead research efforts, supervise teams, coordinate with director & consultants, contribute to report writing and co-author Journal articles. Conduct field surveys, and in-depth interviews in the designated districts. Assist in ranking of District/Developing Economic Survey/Development Reports. Knowledge of MS-Office/Google Suite/Packages for Data analysis like SPSS/Stata. Capable to collect primary data from blocks and villages. Lead Survey/Profiling efforts, Lead Teams, contribute to Report Writing. Assist in ranking of District/Developing Economic Survey/Development Reports. Knowledge of MS-Office/Google Suite/Packages for Data analysis like SPSS/Stata. Capable to collect primary data from blocks and villages.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Lucknow University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your application along with a detailed CV. Send the application and CV through E-mail only to [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches latest by 24.10.2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview or selection process. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a temporary and contractual basis for a period of 11 months. Payment will be based on the satisfactory performance of the candidate. Empaneled candidates shall have no right or claim for regularization, regular, or contractual appointment in the center after the completion of the specified project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or selection process.
